notes.title: Version 0.5.0 is live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The new, major version of Synthetica: Cyber Club Manager is live. This is a huge milestone for the project because the core gameplay is here. You can craft and level up your Android workers, match them with clients' desires, buy new parts, participate in dialogues, and manage your club for days. This is amazing, but much work remains. We can switch our focus to content and secondary gameplay mechanics, such as research, boosts, perks, ratings, etc. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897959/870257eb3f1428c79bb6a475a7c105c15d10347d.jpg[/img]

I hope we can start public playtests in a few months and that you will join us in the unique world of cyber club management!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897959/f587bee98995619b750f7d93213852c04f2b27d5.jpg[/img]

[b]Changelist:[/b]
[list]
[*]A full-scale dialogue system with interactive events, stories, and results. Interact with your clients and help them solve their issues and problems.
[*]Reworked client interaction and overall behavior in the club. Clients can finally wait for the free spot and walk around the club. The overall interaction system is reworked to be more consistent and easier to understand
[*]Parts broker now sells parts to craft the new Androids
[*]Android creation system, craft components, skill leveling, and Android disassembly mechanics.
[*]New Day Result screen with graphs and improved readability
[*]Interactive "Conversation" events with clients, with Theme Selection and the overall base for "interaction mini-games" during the management phase.
[*]New animations for interactions
[*]Dancefloors (though it's a programmer's art at this stage)
[*]Reworked garbage cleanup and visualization
[*]Foundation for Research System
[*]Infinite bugfixes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897959/8f07aec338f5fcaf578fe6ac73cf26087e20808d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update v.0.4.6
notes.content:
The latest version of [i]Synthetica: Cyber Club Manager[/i] is live! This update brings some of our biggest changes yet as we continue building out the core gameplay systems and features. With new UI improvements, expanded android interactions, and the foundation of research mechanics, the game is getting closer to its full vision. Jump in and let us know what you think!

[b]Changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] Reworked UI
[*] New Android Creation Screen
[*] Improved dialogue system
[*] Foundation for research mechanics
[*] New client interactions
[*] Android customization options
[*] Reworked camera system
[*] Various bugfixes and tweaks
[/list]

Don't forget to [b]wishlist the game[/b]!

notes.title: Version 0.3.0!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Version 0.3.0 of Synthetica: Cyber Club Manager is live on Steam! We had a bunch of internal builds between 0.2 and 0.3, but from now on, there will be more updates on Steam. We spent a lot of time finalizing the game's vision, features, and most UI mockups. Now we can move to the active production phase and I hope we'll be able to give access to the playtest build in a month or two.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897959/0ab3331d422e7a9618d2172af847dbe3cae5028b.png[/img]

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Skills for your androids!
[*] News generation system
[*] Another UI overhaul. We redesigned every screen and laid the ground for future UI implementation.
[*] New indication for available actions
[*] Reworked client queue
[*] The player can now open and close the club to control the number of clients
[*] The player can finish the interactions with current clients at the end of the day
[*] Rent payment is now every 3 days, not each day as before
[*] Lots of fixes in UI, AI and core systems
[/list]

Stay tuned for more updates and don't forget to wishlist the game!

notes.title: Version 0.2.0!
notes.content:
Finally, a major update version! We're slowly moving forward both with the visual style and the overall gameplay loop. The base for the game is here, but a lot of things should be improved and deepened. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897959/e9cfc957515a3fbd1ef57f9e8b98018d1916a55b.png[/img]

[b]Changelog[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked visual style for the club interior. Still WIP, but now it's way closer to the desired state and quality
[*] New android girls
[*] Infinite AI and flow tweaks
[*] "Easy" clients who only need some basic entertainment or drinks
[*] Reworked garbage and cleanliness logic
[*] UI tweaks (animation, states, overall UX)
[*] Bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: v.0.1.8 is live!
notes.content:
[b]v.0.1.8 is live![/b]

We're moving forward with the core gameplay systems, AI and overall UX. We still have a lot of things to do, but we're getting close to the actual playable loop :D

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved game settings
[*]Semi-debug button to skip time until the next client
[*]Fixed emotions spam
[*]UI tweaks
[*]AI tweaks
[*]Separate Continue and New Game handling
[*]Decreased game day length
[*]Improved character-android interaction handling
[*]Fixed craft menu progress bar indication
[*]Fixed incorrect waypoint location for Androids after exiting the room
[/list]
